# Read the input tokens
tokens = input().split()

# Extract the first token (fof) and the second token (oja)
fof = tokens[0]
oja = tokens[1]

# Calculate the number of steps
steps = len(fof) - 1

# Determine the first item of the chain
first_item = fof[steps]

# Determine the second item of the chain
second_item = oja[steps]

# Extract the remaining tokens
remaining = fof[steps+1:] + oja[steps+1:]

# Combine the first and second items into a single string
result = first_item + second_item + ',' + remaining

# Print the result
print(result)
